BiblicalUsage: lḗthē means forgetfulness, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In 2 Peter 1:9, "and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe forgetting what Christ purged is the blindness Peter warns about — the man who forgets he was cleansed cannot see afar off.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
